text:
diego_seo: Quick planning thread 1 launch posts -> pillar -> webinar funnel. Need keyword map, minimal schema, redirects, and inbound routing.

julia_growth: Goals: publish launch blog that supports benchmark narrative, drive webinar signups, and route leads to SDR.

sara_writer: Seed keywords: ai-inference-costs; low-latency-llm; production-llm-serving; dedicated-vs-hosted-inference; llm-benchmarks-2026. I'll map to URLs.

mike_prod: One primary KW per page + H1/H2. Confirm pillar canonical at /benchmarks/llm-inference-2026. Webinar landing at /webinar/llm-benchmarks-2026.

diego_seo: Internal links: each launch post -> 2 contextual links to pillar + 1 to webinar. Webinar links to pillar + gated download. Anchor guidance: natural phrases, not exact-match spam.

julia_growth: Landing should be concise and indexable; point readers to pillar for full data. No noindex.

sara_writer: Canonical plan: self-canonical for all pages. Deprecated promos -> 301 to pillar.

diego_seo: Redirect examples for eng (nginx):
```nginx
location = /old-promo { return 301 https://redwood.example.com/benchmarks/llm-inference-2026; }
```

mike_prod: HubSpot: capture utm_source, utm_campaign, page_slug hidden fields. Routing rule: utm_campaign=webinar_benchmark -> SDR_BENCH queue.

diego_seo: Schema: small Event JSON-LD on webinar landing + BreadcrumbList + dataset snippet for key metrics. Minimal Event sample:
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"LLM Serving Benchmarks 2026","startDate":"2026-05-12T16:00:00-07:00","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.example.com/webinar/llm-benchmarks-2026"}}
```

sara_writer: I'll add speakers and CTA markup. Also prepare a trimmed dataset JSON-LD for the benchmark table.

diego_seo: Pre-launch checklist: meta title <=70 chars; meta desc ~150 chars; OG image; structured data validated; >=2 internal links; canonical tag present; sitemap updated.

mike_prod: Ensure download thank-you URLs use short-lived token redirects (302) and avoid indexing. Preserve UTM params on redirects.

diego_seo: seo-bot, run daily crawl of /benchmarks/llm-inference-2026 for 7 days post-launch; alert #marketing if >50 404s.

seo-bot: scheduled crawl /benchmarks/llm-inference-2026; frequency: daily; window:7d; alert:#marketing; threshold:50 404s.

julia_growth: Owners/times: sara_writer -> drafts + KW mapping by Thu EOD; diego_seo -> schema + redirects by Fri noon; mike_prod -> form + HS mapping by next Tue; eng -> redirect rules in staging by next Wed. Pre-launch review 09:30 PT tomorrow.

sara_writer: will post spreadsheet link and sample meta copy before the call.

diego_seo: thanks all :rocket:
